Nestle to remove artificial colorings from products globally by 2026

Food giant Nestle has announced plans to eliminate artificial colorings from all its products worldwide by the end of 2026. This decision comes as part of the company's ongoing efforts to reformulate its offerings. The move is expected to impact a wide range of consumer goods.
